page.overview:
What is Footprint?

The Footprint was a joke item from Java Edition 20w14∞, found only in the dimension.

This item is semi-transparent with a grey colour scheme.

Footprints were obtained only from a chest in the dimension. Only existing in 2020 April fools snapshot 20w14∞, it cannot exist in any non-April Fool's joke versions and April Fool's joke versions before or after 20w14∞. There is a maximum of 2 footprints that can be obtained legitimately in any given world.

Despite these footprints not being available in the creative inventory, it is still possible to acquire them via the command or duplicating them by holding down middle-click whilst in creative mode.
